listing.name: Fuse — FuseRecomp (nikolaygorb)
listing.summary: Upstream reports offline gameplay, audio, video, achievements and saves. Online play is unsupported. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own complete extracted Fuse Xbox 360 files, including the original executable: title ID 4541096E, media ID 566B2842. Upstream names module hash 34AD8CB8A7A6A172 without specifying its algorithm; check its exact file requirements before setup.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract your own Fuse disc into assets, then build with CMake and ReXGlue following upstream instructions.

warnings: Upstream reports offline gameplay, audio, video, achievements and saves. Online play is unsupported.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
